rationale: Three-lens review (blind, edge-case, acceptance) of a 9-file, +311/-43 frontend diff. Acceptance lens audited all 8 EPMCDME-14584 criteria against source: all pass (backend test:true support confirmed present in ConnectOAuthRequest.test). Edge-case lens returned no findings, confirming against source that the auth_type=oauth marker is present in credentialValues on the Edit pages, MASKED_VALUE matches the sensitive-field mask, git is non-testable, resolveOAuthVariant cannot throw, the create flow is unregressed, and the three connect endpoints/store methods match. Blind lens raised 3 majors: #2 (Jira/Confluence branches use bare identifiers instead of value()) is a FALSE POSITIVE caused by an abbreviated diff in the lens prompt — the real code uses value('client_id')/value('client_secret')/value('callback_base_url') in every branch; #1 (masked-secret path tests stored config rather than unsaved non-secret field edits) is a known, previously-accepted trade-off since sending the mask to /initiate is strictly worse; #3 (masked secret with no settingId leaking to /initiate) is theoretical with no real path (create flow uses freshly typed secrets, confirmed by edge-case). Dismissed: 1 (blind #2 false positive). Deferred (non-blocking): blind #1 stale-config-on-edit trade-off; blind #3 theoretical; and a minor latent over-match where isFoldedOAuth also matches SharePoint auth_type=oauth (benign today — SharePoint is non-testable and resolveOAuthVariant returns undefined for it). No critical/major finding survived verification. Security risk flag reviewed: the masked secret is never posted; connect-with-test posts only {setting_id, test}; no secret in URL or logs. Note: no commits exist yet (held for user permission), so git-workflow commit-format check is N/A this round.
